Subject: Discrepancy in Mar-Apr usage / request for reconciliation

Hi Vanessa,

We were going over our April invoice and noticed a large bump in inference hours during late March that doesn't line up with our internal tracking. The attached CSV shows our exported usage (OpsLab_usage_report_Mar-Apr.csv) — you can see a 45% spike for the week of 3/22–3/28 compared to our dashboard.

We think some long-running batch jobs were incorrectly routed and consumed dedicated capacity during the billing period. Can Redwood help reconcile and, if necessary, provide a one-time makeup credit? We have a renewal coming up and want to resolve this before the amendment is executed.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Elaine Park

Hi Elaine — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the export. I reviewed the CSV and our raw request logs and see the spike you called out (3/22–3/28). Preliminary look: several large inference jobs were routed to Dedicated pool "redwood-ded-45" during that window because of a misconfigured routing rule tied to an experimental route.

Plan proposal:
- We will run a line-by-line reconciliation and produce a reconciliation workbook that maps OpsLab request IDs to billed tokens/hours.
- If we confirm the routing error, Redwood will issue a one-time makeup credit equal to the overbilled portion (calculated as the difference between billed hours and validated OpsLab hours for the period).
- We can fold the credit into a contract amendment (one-off credit on the next invoice) or issue a standalone credit note — whatever OpsLab prefers.

Next steps from our side: Ben (cc'd) will partner with me on the reconciliation and coordinate an internal approval for any one-time credit; Laura will draft the amendment language if you want the credit documented alongside the renewal.

Can you confirm: do you want us to proceed with a full reconciliation and draft amendment? If yes, please share any PPT/notes you used for the internal hour counts so we can align on methodology.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
